flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for the court application submission confirmation screen. Only UI data types/stubs and a court-process/process-cpc call in ocmsadminui NoticeUPL useEndorsement with no backend controller; no list + count summary screen, confirm button or back action.
note: The story asks for a confirmation screen: the reviewed notice list, a count summary, then the CPO confirms submit or goes back to the review screen. There is no screen, route or endpoint for it in the six repos. The 'Court Application Submit Reports' entry is only a placeholder (Report/index.tsx:65-68, empty path). The court-process/process-cpc endpoint (useEndorsement.tsx:220-226) is called from the UPL endorsement flow and has no controller in the repo. Submission to State Courts: cannot verify from repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as completed based on this repo. Confirm with URA/the team where the confirmation screen and the submit-to-State-Courts code live.
